claims.claim: [5] Personal data includes direct and indirect identifiers; no-account scope does not establish their absence.
[6] Privacy principles include lawful basis, transparency, minimisation and storage limitation.
[7] Where GDPR transfer rules apply, establish applicable transfer basis/conditions for transfers outside the EEA; no exemption for this project established.
[8] Gemini terms distinguish EEA paid-client eligibility from EEA paid data-use protection; paid content not used for product improvement but security/global processing remains.
[9] Gemini abuse monitoring retains prompt/context/output for 55 days and permits authorised flagged-content review.
[10] Gemini Files objects expire after 48 hours and support deletion; not an all-copy guarantee.
[11] Optional Generate Content logs default on for projects created from 2026-10-26; automatic marked-for-deletion period and dataset sharing differ from abuse monitoring.
[12] Gemini retention documentation distinguishes feature-specific storage and does not establish guaranteed zero retention for this design.
[13] Kopinor/UHR model agreement has internal-use and recipient limits, bars public internet publication and separately excludes training absent permission/law; institutional adoption unverified.
